name: Execution Quality Check
description: The first month of standardized SEC Rule 605 execution-quality reports (August 2026), made comparable: reporter-by-reporter spread, price-improvement and execution statistics for exchanges and broker-dealers, plus a per-symbol explorer and a coverage ledger of who has and has not published — exactly as filed, with hash receipts and documented data-quality notes.
data_source: Amended-format SEC Rule 605 reports for August 2026 from the exchanges' own sites (Cboe, IEX, MIAX, MEMX, Nasdaq), the shared Download Site host that NYSE, 24X and most broker-dealers use, and firm-hosted Download Sites: detailed 55-field pipe-delimited files + OES summary CSVs, fetched with SHA-256 receipts
records: 169 reporters; 17,708,940 detailed rows; 14,534 symbols; 4,127 published summary rows; 151 of 223 FINRA-registered firms in the build. Restated files fetched 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-23; Park Avenue Securities verified 2026-10-21 as PAWM (formerly PASC), unchanged apart from its reporter code. Nine reporter codes restated and are shown from the later fetches; Moomoo (FUTM) returned HTTP 404 and is omitted.
detail: Reporter comparison by order size band × stock universe × order type across the published statistics (price improvement, at-quote rate, effective/quoted spread, EFQ, realized spreads), sortable and filterable by reporter type; per-symbol explorer comparing every reporter that filed records for a stock; coverage ledger of every FINRA-registered reporter (in the build / registered with no file located / Download Site not retrieved) with probe evidence; method page with file receipts, per-reporter unit checks, sanity filters and filing anomalies found during the build.
asymmetry: Brokers and venues benefit when execution quality stays fragmented across hundreds of separate monthly downloads; the standardized format exists so executions can be compared, but nobody has assembled the comparison. Investors comparing venues — or checking whether their fills are measurably worse than the market's — need the portage layer: many Download Sites → searchable, comparable tables.
pipeline_note: Header-driven parsing of the 55-field detailed files, parallel per reporter; executed shares = executed at the reporter + executed away (price-improvement share checked against the published S&P 500/other bracket: 857/857 reporter-size cells on the 2026-10-18 re-fetch); EFQ units detected per reporter from the filed rows and cross-checked against the summary (6 reporters write percent-points and are normalized); headerless, gz, nested-zip and alias-code filings handled and recorded; conservative row-sanity filters for weighted statistics only (exclusions counted per reporter); notional fields excluded due to sentinel-value anomalies; nil, IOC-only and summary-less reporters kept and labeled; 256-way symbol shards by a Python/JS FNV-1a pair with an all-symbols parity test; 2026-10-04 post-deadline harvest build, Playwright browser smoke over the staged site; static, no backend. Re-fetched 2026-10-18: CHAS, JANY, JANM, SFBD, SFMM, JNST and JSJX had replaced their August files, and the page shows those current files (first-filed bytes kept with the source build). FUTM returned HTTP 404 and is not shown. On 2026-10-23, applied CODX detailed and MLWM detailed/summary replacements found by the full-source freshness checker; prior working files retained.
